title: 第9章 大快人心第10章 有些乱
content_zh:
“怎么回事？”
少女疑惑地睁开双眼，这才发现不知道什么时候，她的身前出现了一道背影，这背影虽然算不上高大，但这一刻这背影在阳光的照射下却是那么伟岸，简直是光芒万丈。
此时，这道背影的主人抓住了其中一位跟班的手，随后用力一拧。
咔擦一声脆响，清晰无比。
这位跟班的手当时就脱臼了，杀猪一般的惨叫回荡在整个校园。
另外一位跟班看见此人的容貌之后，更是吓得不停后退。
“张……张逸风！”
这挡在少女身前的人，自然是张逸风。五天过去，提升修为的药丸已经熬练出来了，由于房租快要到期，他也不能一直待在别墅，所以他收拾了行礼准备先回学校住着，赚了钱之后，再去重新租一间房，但他刚刚回到校园，就看见了方才的一幕。
此时，张逸风一只手托着行李箱，一只手云从容地拍了拍自己身上的灰尘，显得云淡风轻。
张逸风身后，少女的心砰砰直跳，居然有人英雄救美，这简直是每个女人都有的少女清洁啊！
但奇怪的是，这背影怎么这么熟悉呢？总感觉在哪里见过。
等等，张逸风……
我去，不会是他吧？
就在少女心思复杂的时候，张逸风转过了身，看清楚张逸风的容貌，少女不知道该哭还是该笑。
“怎么是你！”
此人，不正是霸占她主卧的那个讨厌鬼吗！
张逸风看着少女，淡淡道：“怎么？说这话是不打算谢我了？算了，我也不用你谢，我又不是帮你。”
说着，张逸风去到了赵龙身边，拍了拍赵龙的肩膀，什么话也没说。随后他转头看向于超，眼神冰冷，犹如刀剑。
于超被张逸风的眼神吓了一跳，到底是怎样的经历，才能拥有这样冰冷的眼神啊？万幸的是眼神不能杀人。
调整了一下心态，他于超再怎么也是经开大学有名的混混，怎么能被一个眼神吓倒：“张小……逸风，你来得正好，我还以为你怕了超爷爷我，所以躲起来了。”

于超“硬气”地开口！
张逸风冷冷看着于超，淡淡道：“看来上次我出手还太轻了。这一次你是想躺多长时间？十天半月，还是半年。”
于超没有回答，而是冷哼道：“张逸风，你别嚣张，我已经打电话叫人了，有种别走。”
张逸风笑了，道：“原来叫人了，怪不得这次不跑。对了，你刚才说什么？有种别走？正好，我这个人向来有种。”
声音还在飘荡，张逸风一步步走向了于超。
“你……你干什么！有种别过来，等我二十分钟！”
这一次换做于超害怕了，张逸风的身手他是见识过的，何况他方现在有两个伤员，绝对不是张逸风的对手。
content_en:
"What's going on?"
The girl opened her eyes in confusion, and then realized that at some point, a back figure appeared in front of her. Although this back figure was not tall, at this moment, the back figure was so majestic under the sunlight, and it was simply radiant.
At this time, the owner of this silhouette grabbed the hand of one of the followers, and then squeezed it hard.
There was a crisp, clear click.
The follower's hand was dislocated at that time, and his screams, like a slaughtered pig, echoed throughout the campus.
After another follower saw this man's appearance, he was so frightened that he kept retreating.
"Zhang...Zhang Yifeng!"
The person standing in front of the girl was naturally Zhang Yifeng. Five days later, the pills for improving cultivation have been worked out. Since the rent was about to expire, he could not stay in the villa forever, so he packed up his gifts and prepared to go back to school to live there. After making money, he went to rent a new room. But as soon as he returned to campus, he saw the scene just now.
At this time, Zhang Yifeng was holding the suitcase with one hand, and calmly patted the dust on his body with the other hand, looking calm and relaxed.
Behind Zhang Yifeng, the girl's heart was beating fast. There was actually a hero saving the beauty. This is the girlish cleanliness that every woman has!
But the strange thing is, why does this back look so familiar? I always feel like I’ve seen it somewhere.
Wait, Zhang Yifeng...
Let me go, it won’t be him, right?
Just when the girl was having complicated thoughts, Zhang Yifeng turned around and saw Zhang Yifeng's face clearly. The girl didn't know whether to cry or laugh.
"Why is it you!"
Isn't this person the nasty guy who occupied her master bedroom?
Zhang Yifeng looked at the girl and said calmly: "What? Are you saying this to thank me? Forget it, I don't need you to thank me. I'm not helping you."
With that said, Zhang Yifeng went to Zhao Long and patted Zhao Long on the shoulder without saying anything. Then he turned to look at Yu Chao, his eyes as cold as swords.
Yu Chao was startled by Zhang Yifeng's eyes. What kind of experience did he have to have such cold eyes? Fortunately, looks can't kill.
After adjusting his mentality, Yu Chao was a well-known gangster at Jingkai University, so how could he be intimidated by a look: "Zhang Xiao...Yifeng, you came just in time. I thought you were afraid of Grandpa Chao and me, so you hid."
Yu Chao spoke "strongly"!
Zhang Yifeng looked at Yu Chao coldly and said calmly: "It seems that I was too gentle last time. How long do you want to lie down this time? Ten days and a half, or half a year."
Yu Chao did not answer, but snorted coldly: "Zhang Yifeng, don't be arrogant, I have already called someone, don't leave if you have the guts."
Zhang Yifeng smiled and said: "So I called someone, no wonder I didn't run away this time. By the way, what did you just say? Don't leave if you have the guts? It just so happens that I've always had the guts."
The voice was still floating, and Zhang Yifeng walked towards Yu Chao step by step.
"You...what are you doing! Come here if you have the guts, wait for me for twenty minutes!"
Yu Chao was scared this time. He had seen Zhang Yifeng's skills before. What's more, there were two wounded on his side, and they were definitely no match for Zhang Yifeng.
